hints.tr: Parantez okumayı kolaylaştırır: `(A and B) or C`.
hints.en: Parentheses make it easier to read: `(A and B) or C`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
year = int(input("Year: "))
if (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or year % 400 == 0:
    print("leap year")
else:
    print("not a leap year")
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
year = int(input("Year: "))
if (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or year % 400 == 0:
    print("leap year")
else:
    print("not a leap year")
```
